fixture_name: M5 Junction 10 Improvements — UK Stage 1 (real scheme, OGL)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: The finding identifies a genuine VRU refuge-width hazard at a Stage 1 junction location.
justifications.evidence_grounding: A verbatim quote directly supports the pivotal refuge-width/cyclist-clipping safety claim.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: It is correctly framed as a safety concern rather than a compliance question under the Stage 1 RSA context.
justifications.recommendation_quality: It gives a specific, actionable refuge sizing requirement for named vulnerable users.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians, cyclists, and pushchair users are explicitly considered.

justifications.substance: Large-vehicle swept-path validity at a signalised junction is a substantive compliance and safety verification issue.
justifications.evidence_grounding: The cited quote supports prior swept-path analysis and vehicle types but not the stop-line repositioning validity claim.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: The finding stays a compliance question and does not conflate verification with an asserted safety defect.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Re-running swept-path analysis for the adjusted stop-line positions is specific, actionable and viable.
justifications.vru_coverage: Vulnerable road users are acknowledged, but the question is scoped to large-vehicle swept paths, so score 1.
